name: VT Co., Ltd.
summary: VT Co., Ltd. engages in the manufacture and distribution of cosmetics in South Korea and internationally. It also offers lithium sulfur batteries and electrode structure manufacturing devices; and hydrogen energy solutions, as well as laminating business. The company was formerly known as VT GMP Co.,Ltd. and changed its name to VT Co., Ltd. in July 2023. VT Co., Ltd. was founded in 1986 and is headquartered in Paju-si, South Korea.
